items.headline: Source: Buccaneers pass rusher Yaya Diaby has Grade 2 MCL sprain
Saquon Barkley has assurances he won't be traded, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'

Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1

Ravens QB Lamar Jackson will have surgery on his thumb and will go on Injured Reserve, per coach Jesse Minter.
Jaguars WR Jakobi Meyers, questionable with hamstring and ankle injuries, is good to go today, per source.
Jets RB Braelon Allen is slated to start again for the Jets, with Breece Hall still dealing with that quad injury.
